items.example: She has a typical Virgo personality, always paying great attention to details and focusing on high-end aesthetic designs.
According to the astrology magazine, people born under Gemini are usually very communicative, highly adaptable, and full of wit.

items.chinese: 星座、黃道帶 / 星座標誌
items.example: Before planning their holiday or analyzing their relationship fortune, they love to check their Western zodiac signs and Eastern Bazi elements.
There is a common stereotype that all English language teachers are incredibly strict, but she proves that educators can be very supportive and grounded.
In modern relationships, being overly controlling can damage mutual trust, so it is important to give each other enough private space.

items.chinese: 愛整潔、把每樣東西收拾得乾乾淨淨
items.example: She prefers a minimalist lifestyle, always working hard to keep everything tidy and clean on her professional desk.
For freelance educators, delivering a high-quality online presentation is an excellent way to attract potential clients.
After deep negotiations regarding the teaching modules, the two training centers finally decided to sign a contract.
She values professional ethics deeply, which makes her a highly trusted business partner in the local educational industry.
Achieving a score of 7.5 on the IELTS exam can open up amazing career opportunities if you want to apply for a management role in a foreign company.
Your extensive experience in TESOL perfectly matches the qualifications needed for this distance learning master's program.

items.chinese: 全職工作 / 兼職工作
items.example: Although her main job is teaching English at a language school, she also takes on freelance consulting as a satisfying part-time job.

items.chinese: 居家辦公、遠程辦公（常縮寫為 WFH）
items.example: Operating a freelance education business gives her the absolute freedom to work from home and manage her own curriculum schedule.

items.chinese: 提升、改善、提高（常用於技能、語言、能力）
items.example: She designed a special vocabulary tracking system to help her A2-level students improve their language proficiency faster.

items.chinese: 增長、增加（常用於數量、數字、比例）
items.example: The main purpose of this mock test strategy is to increase the number of correct answers in the IELTS reading section.

items.chinese: 適合的、適宜的（可完美替代 fit）
items.example: This analytical reading textbook is highly suitable for students who are preparing for advanced post-graduate qualifications.
While she delivers her presentations in professional British English, her native language is standard Mandarin.
At the beginning of the term, some students had a strong local accent, but they quickly improved after listening to standard audio inputs.
Her ultimate goal is to help her students not only pass the IELTS exam but also communicate fluently in a professional British environment.
When teaching grammar modules, it is essential to explain how the comparative form differs from the superlative form.
To improve your speaking output, you must first accumulate a large amount of high-quality reading and listening input.
Understanding educational psychology can help teachers design better motivation strategies for students during their learning plateaus.
She regularly reads advanced magazines to keep up with global financial trends and economic updates.
Her teaching philosophy focuses on inspiring students' critical thinking rather than making them memorise phrases mechanically.
The analytical report in The Economist provides deep insights into how geopolitical events affect the global stock market.
The premium boutique hotel uses high-aesthetic vintage portraits to attract sophisticated travelers.
Instead of digital articles, she prefers reading physical copies of analytical magazines during her weekend coffee time.
Reading The Economist regularly is an excellent way for advanced students to build sophisticated vocabulary for the IELTS reading test.
Seeing her students overcome their learning plateaus and speak English fluently gives her a strong sense of achievement.
Saying "I have a million things to do today" is a classic example of hyperbole that we use frequently in daily spoken English.
Freelance educators usually require their graduate school applicants to hand in their personal statements before the weekend deadline.

items.chinese: 開展合作、建立合作關係
items.example: The local training center managed to strike up cooperation with a premium distance learning institution in the UK.
We were ready to sign the contract, but unfortunately, the entire business deal fell through at the last minute due to financial disagreements.

items.chinese: 沉浸式閱讀、把自己埋首於閱讀中
items.example: On a rainy weekend afternoon, she loves to sit in a quiet armchair with a cup of hot latte and completely immerse herself in reading Peter Hessler's latest book.
I keep a healthy daily routine every weekday. 我平日維持規律的日常作息。
The heavy workload makes me feel tired easily. 龐大的工作量讓我容易感到疲累。
My workstation is near the office window. 我的工位靠近辦公室窗邊。
I need to wrap up daily tasks before getting off work. 我下班前必須收尾日常工作。
Please elaborate your opinions in the meeting. 請在會議中詳細闡述你的看法。
I will make a work presentation this Friday. 這週五我要進行工作匯報。
Strict rules make new staff feel threatened. 嚴格的制度讓新人感到備受威脅。
He is good at getting along with his subordinates. 他善於和下屬相處。
Too many trivial tasks waste my working time. 過多瑣碎雜事耗費我的工作時間。
Long meetings will drain energy quickly. 長時間開會會快速消耗精力。
Good cross-rank communication helps work go smoothly. 良好的跨層級溝通有助工作順利進行。
I can take independent charge of this new project. 我能夠獨立負責這項新專案。
Please do not disturb me when I am busy working. 我忙於工作時請不要打擾我。
We need to negotiate about the working time. 我們需要針對工作時間進行溝通協商。
This is just a superficial idea without deep thinking. 這只是淺顯表面、未經深思的想法。
She still keeps full passion for her job. 她依舊對工作滿懷熱忱。
Proper rest can raise working enthusiasm. 適當休息能提升工作積極性。
I feel exhausted after finishing all the work. 完成所有工作後我身心俱疲。
Some small companies will have layoffs in off-seasons. 部分小公司淡季會進行裁員。
Long repeated work leads to career stagnation. 長期重複工作會造成職涯停滯不前。
This channel has more than ten thousand subscribers. 這個頻道擁有上萬名訂閱用戶。
Many graduates come to apply for vacant positions. 許多畢業生前來應聘空缺崗位。
Finishing hard tasks brings great achievement. 完成困難任務能帶來滿滿成就感。
Design work needs rich creativity very much. 設計類工作十分需要豐富創造力。
As an introvert, I like working alone. 身為內向的人，我喜歡獨自工作。
Most sales staff are typical extroverts. 多數業務人員都是典型外向的人。
Unique work ideas can attract attention quickly. 獨特的工作想法能快速吸引注意力。
We should learn to reject unreasonable requests. 我們要學會拒絕不合理的要求。
He is a talented young worker in the team. 他是團隊裡有才幹的年輕員工。
I accidentally knew his working plan. 我無意間得知了他的工作計畫。
This position has a strict fixed quota. 這個職位有嚴格的固定名額。
Many people want to escape from busy work. 許多人想要逃離繁忙的工作。

items.english: on purpose / intend to do sth
items.example: She didn't make mistakes on purpose. 她並非故意犯下錯誤。
The company will eliminate low-efficiency workers. 公司將淘汰效率低下的員工。
The doctor checked my mandible for any damage. 醫生檢查了我的下顎骨是否有損傷。
Stress can cause pain in the temporomandibular joint. 壓力可能導致顳顎關節疼痛。
We have a holiday on International Workers’ Day. 國際勞動節我們會放假。
Many people feel tired in a competitive work culture. 很多人在競爭激烈的工作文化中感到疲憊。
Frequent tiredness is a health warning. 經常疲倦是一種健康警訊。
I am planning my annual leave for May. 我正在規劃五月的年假。
He has an active mind and never stops thinking. 他思緒活躍，總是不停思考。
The shop serves many customers, while the lawyer has clients. 這家店有很多顧客，而律師擁有專屬客戶。
They have very different personalities. 他們的性格截然不同。
A moderate level of exercise is good for health. 適度的運動對健康有益。
She can get things done quickly without mistakes. 她能快速又不出錯地把事情做完。

items.chinese: procrastinator 拖延者；planner 規劃者
items.example: I am a planner, but my brother is a procrastinator. 我是個會規劃的人，但我弟弟很愛拖延。

items.chinese: 全神貫注的；深陷其中的
items.example: He is deeply involved in his new project. 他全心投入在新專案上。
It’s easy to immerse yourself in work and forget time. 人很容易沉浸工作而忘記時間。
You can ask for an extension on your course. 你可以申請課程有效期延長。
The validity of the course is one year. 這門課的有效期為一年。
There is a contradiction between his words and actions. 他的言行互相矛盾。
We have conflicting plans for the weekend. 我們週末的計畫互相衝突。
My cheek feels painful after sleeping badly. 我沒睡好，臉頰覺得痛。
My time after work is very limited. 我下班後的時間非常有限。

items.chinese: 日常作息；每日例行公事
items.example: I need to change my daily routine to get more rest. 我需要調整日常作息來多休息。
After “want”, we use the infinitive. want 後面要接不定詞。

items.chinese: 只能接 V-ing 的動詞
items.example: I avoid walking alone at night. 我避免晚上獨自行走。

items.chinese: 可接 to do / doing 的動詞（討厭/喜愛）
items.example: I love listening to music. = I love to listen to music.

items.english: seem / would like / choose / decide / hope
items.chinese: 只能接 to do 的動詞
items.example: I hope to see you soon.

items.chinese: 動詞句式 / 動詞型態
items.example: You need to learn which verb pattern to use after "avoid."（你需要學習在 "avoid" 之後使用哪種動詞句式。）
Planting trees can help reduce carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.（種樹有助於減少大氣中的二氧化碳。）
The server room must be kept at 20 degrees Celsius.（機房必須保持在攝氏 20 度。）
I was awake all night because of a mosquito in my room.（因為房間裡有一隻蚊子，我整晚都沒睡。）
Turn on the air conditioner; it's too hot in here.（開冷氣吧，這裡太熱了。）
The weather in Wuhan is very humid during the summer months.（武漢夏天的天氣非常潮濕。）
He felt frustrated when the software kept crashing.（當軟體不斷當機時，他感到很挫敗。）
The strike disrupted the city’s public transport system.（罷工擾亂了城市的公共交通系統。）
Reading more books will help you express yourself smoothly in English.（多讀書會幫助你用英文流利地表達自己。）
You should avoid using the same password for every website.（你應該避免在每個網站都使用相同的密碼。）
Do you enjoy gardening in your spare time?（你喜歡在閒暇時間從事園藝嗎？）
"On time" is a fixed phrase that means not late.（"On time" 是個固定短語，意思是準時。）
The stadium has a capacity of 50,000 people.（這座體育場可容納五萬人。）
Phrasal verbs are a common type of verb combination.（短語動詞是一種常見的動詞組合。）
It’s hard to choose (v.) when there are so many good choices (n.).（有這麼多好的選擇時，很難做出決定。）
Extract means to pull something out; ex-wife means a former wife.（Extract 是拔出；ex-wife 是前妻。）
He has excellent English pronunciation.（他的英文發音非常好。）

items.chinese: 預期 / 專家 / 提取
items.example: We expect an expert to extract the data from the broken drive.（我們預期會有一位專家從壞掉的硬碟中提取數據。）
The tech company had to lay off 200 workers this month.（這間科技公司這個月不得不裁員 200 人。）
Tencent is one of the largest technology companies in the world.（騰訊是全球最大的科技公司之一。）
This color combination looks very professional.（這個顏色組合看起來非常專業。）
Taking on another project will significantly increase my workload.（接手另一個專案會顯著增加我的工作量。）
Finishing the task gives me a strong sense of achievement.
